title: Chirpdesk plugin manifest
description: Shape of plugin.json for every plugin kind. Chirpdesk.Core.Plugins.PluginLoader is the authority at runtime; this file documents the contract for plugin authors and editors. Unknown properties are ignored, so a newer manifest still loads on an older app unless a required value is unsupported.

id.description: Lowercase, immutable across versions. Must match the folder name and the service definition.

version.description: The plugin's own version. The repository index must sign the same value.

apiVersion.description: Host API this plugin targets. A higher number is refused.

permissions.description: tools, read-storage, trim-cache and storage are bundled-only in v1. inject-js and process are refused in v1.

assets.description: Plain file names inside the plugin folder. No separators, no parent segments.
